fixture_notice: Synthetic local fixture for offline evaluation. Willow County, organizations, schedules, and phone numbers are fictional.
community: A fictional unincorporated valley of 40 households in Willow County
request: An offline-first preparedness and communication guide for a multi-day power or communications outage.
constraints: Internet and cellular service may be unavailable for 48 hours.
Some households have no smartphone, car, generator, or reliable indoor heating.
A few residents use mobility aids and cannot reach the ridge on foot.
Do not publish private medical details or imply that volunteers provide professional emergency care.

requires battery radio and may not reach the valley floor
works only when the phone network is operating
not accessible to everyone and no resident should be required to travel there

claims: Use two independent channels when possible; leave a paper status mark at a household's agreed location only with consent.
The library can print 60 large-print cards before its backup battery is exhausted.

unknowns: Which households want a check-in and which accessible locations are currently usable are not confirmed.
